My fireteam and I have zero problem getting to the end boss, but from there we can't do anything. We have a 34 Titan, 34 Hunter, and 33 Warlock, and we're all pretty frustrated.
Do you guys have any tips for the 34 PoE?

The boss himself has very little health. Two approaches that you can try here: 1. If gjallarhorns are on hand, treat it like a solar burn, but before burning him down, take out all adds. As soon as you have a clean playing field, just unload on him with all your rockets. He really doesn't take that many to drop, so 3 guardians focusing with Gjallars will do it. 2. If no gjallarhorns, try to use a method we used on Skolas - use snipers on the servitor, and blast all adds with whatever rockets you have. The dreg minions are the only thing that can ruin your good times, so if you can work the servitor into a good spot, and just burst DPS the dregs while sniping down the boss, you'll see him fall quickly. In this approach, it sometimes works better if you have split duties, with one/two guy(s) sniping and the rest rocketing adds, and rotating when rocket ammo runs out.

Either way, the name of the game is speed damage. whether it is focused on the boss or the dreg minions, one or the other cannot last in the arena without significantly dragging the fight out further.

Work your way to the left platform immediately and focus on only the adds. Once all the adds are down do as much damage to the boss as possible. You can burn him down with 2-3 Ghorns very easily with synths or Blackhammers. If you don't have those luxury items just try your best to widdle him down and work on the adds and repeat. The main objective is to do as much spike damage as possible to him in that shirt amount of time so he doesn't fully recover from the ether.

I guarantee they do it at Whataburger (which I had for the first time when I moved out here and think is wonderful). By and large, the people who open carry want as little trouble as possible. They're like radically responsible. If a store manager told them they didn't want them to open carry in their store, they'd leave immediately and either shop somewhere else or else drive all the way back home, put their gun away, and then go back to the store. Though, as I understand it, getting a concealed carry permit is ridiculously easy out here so it's probably a non-issue for most people who want to be armed when they eat fast food.
